caption: the Files panel on a fresh install of WhereQ-DOSBox 1.0.0.19 - no games yet, and the gold "Install a bundle (.zip)" button that starts the import
the Android file picker, opened on the Downloads folder, with tou-jin-zi.zip selected - the bundle the PC Legends page for 偷金子 (Lode Runner) offers
the Files panel again, now with tou-jin-zi installed - its entry point LR.COM, its size, and the Play / States / Launch… / Remove buttons
Android asking whether WhereQ-DOSBox may send notifications - the foreground service needs it, and it is the only prompt the app ever shows on its own
偷金子 (Lode Runner) running inside WhereQ-DOSBox 1.0.0.19, framed by the two-pad on-screen keyboard
the Files panel over the running game, with a green Resume tou-jin-zi line above the list
the DOSBox welcome banner and the C:\> prompt, with the two-pad on-screen keyboard below it
Game Mode, Hybrid profile - the 8-way d-pad, L-CLICK and R-CLICK on the left; Y, X, CTRL, ALT, the trackball, SPACE and ENT on the right
the Game profile picker, opened by a long press on the gold profile button - Hybrid, Action, Point & click, and Remap buttons…
the Action profile - the 8-way d-pad on the left, and the face-button diamond (ENT, USE, JUMP, FIRE) on the right
the Point & click profile - no d-pad, but big LEFT and RIGHT mouse buttons, the trackball, and the DRAG lock and double-click chips
remap mode - the buttons that can be changed are outlined in gold, under a banner that says Tap a button to remap
back to the plain keyboard pads after the reverse Konami code (↑↑↓↓←→←→, then X and Y) - the game is still running underneath
the Save states sheet for tou-jin-zi - three empty slots, and Load saves from a folder… at the foot
the Keep your saves safe? prompt, right after the first save - choose a folder and the app will mirror every slot into it, compressed
the Android access dialog for the DOSSaves folder, with CANCEL and ALLOW - Android will not hand an app the whole Download folder, so the app asks for one of its own
the Files panel with Resume tou-jin-zi · slot 1 · just now - the slot is named and dated, so you know what you are resuming
the Save states sheet with the slot filled in - Slot 1 · 1 minute ago, and the Load button is now live
the Settings dialog - CPU core, and the Saves folder row that points at the folder you chose
the Saves folder dialog, with a folder set - every save-state is mirrored there, compressed, next to the game itself
the same dialog on a fresh install - No folder set, so the saves are kept only inside the app and are lost if it is uninstalled
the folder on the phone after the app was uninstalled - tou-jin-zi is still there, because it was never inside the app
the Restore games prompt - This folder has 1 game that is not installed. Restore it now?
Restored 1 game(s). Your saves are ready. - tou-jin-zi is back in the Files panel, with its save-state
the restored slot still says 6 minutes ago - a save made before the reinstall still knows when it was made
the punctuation layer of the on-screen keyboard, with the #+= key lit
the function layer, with the Fn key lit - F1 to F12
the WhereQ-DOSBox icon on the launcher, the way a player finds it after installing
the Android App info page for WhereQ-DOSBox
the ongoing notification WhereQ-DOSBox leaves in the shade - the foreground service that keeps the machine resident while the player is in another app
back in the game after tapping the notification - the emulator never stopped, the game is still in play
the app on an 18:9 display - the same two pads, with the letter keys noticeably smaller
